observations: Black UPS unit with a blue vertical stripe on the front panel.
Brand 'BLUE GATE' is embossed on the top right of the front panel in photo 0 and photo 1.
A power button and three status LEDs are visible on the front panel in photo 0.
A 3-pin power plug is attached to the top of the unit in photo 1.
The unit is sitting on a tiled floor.
The rear of the unit is not shown in either photo.

claims.claim: Battery is new, holds charge for 8 hours. Never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The unit may not power on or may have a faulty inverter.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit powering on and the inverter working under load.

risks.risk: The battery may be old, degraded, or unable to hold a charge.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit in battery mode (lights on) and a multimeter reading of the battery voltage.

risks.risk: The unit may be a generic clone rather than a genuine Blue Gate product.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's label on the back or bottom of the unit.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the manufacturer's label on the back or bottom of the unit.
Video of the unit powered on and the inverter working.
Photo of the rear ports and the battery status indicator.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
